glossary.User Config:
Configuration that applies to Roundfix runs started by one developer across repositories.
_Avoid_: Global config, machine config
glossary.Project Config:
Configuration that applies to Roundfix runs inside one repository.
A Task commit includes Project Config only when the frozen Spec authorization bounds `.roundfixrc.yml`; otherwise the Task fails with `Project Config outside the Spec's authorization`, while Batch and QA Report commits never stage Project Config and report the exclusion.
_Avoid_: Local config, repo config
glossary.Roundfix Home:
The user-scoped directory where Roundfix stores configuration and central state across repositories.
_Avoid_: Workspace, artifact directory
glossary.Judge Log:
The per-month JSONL record of every advisory judgment call: the question, the transport that carried it (OpenRouter or TypeSafe), the answer, probabilities, confidence, latency, input tokens, the model the service reported and the call's cost. Its monthly sum is what the spend ceiling reads (ADR-0201).
_Avoid_: Run Event Journal, audit log

reason: It parameterizes the existing spending ceiling of the existing Judge Log, without introducing an entity, lifecycle or alternative synonym. Config scope remains unchanged.

promise_to_observable.configured ceiling, default, validation,: config.Load regression tests plus matching fresh public CLI transcripts
promise_to_observable.judge shared ceiling and JSON: Questions.WithMonthlyCeiling applied in spec_judge.go; tests plus actual text/JSON
promise_to_observable.router gate and bounded monthly key: NewEngine wiring plus local HTTP acceptance at 50/refusal at 5 and over-limit refusal at 50
promise_to_observable.guides and skill synchronize contract: Exact mirror and owned-version digest assertions; checked emitted messages
promise_to_observable.operator User Config changed after merge: No Task commit touches the operator home; documentation instructs the operator; QA uses disposable homes only

non_goals: No config init template, recipients, keys, selection rules, embedded questions or measured thresholds changed; no operator-home writes. Config change is limited to the one key; Git diff corroborates.
confirmation: Checked each claim against concrete consumer/config mechanisms and the actual Task delta; glossary definitions cross-check those scopes, not only presence in CONTEXT.
